detail: Actual English, Lao, Vietnamese, and Thai query batches included weekly windows, province and sector terms, adjacent-month continuity, and searches scoped to KPL, Vientiane Times, VOA Lao, RFA, and other sources. Search results remain sparse and aggregated, and local archives for less-covered provinces were not inspected systematically. No absence inference is justified.
affected_dimensions: less-covered provinces beyond the specific combined search terms
Lao spelling/term variants for public assembly and protest
local/sector archives for workers, students, women, farmers, and religious/ethnic communities
next_permitted_action: Continue ordinary managed discovery with month-specific province and sector terms and inspect permitted public local archives after a fresh URL-specific assessment; do not treat search-engine silence or unrelated missing archives as evidence of zero events.
